extension.summary: Builds a maze around the current time, solves it, and starts again
extension.description:
A Kodi port of ScreenMazer, the macOS screensaver that draws a maze cell by cell and then solves it, over and over. Each maze is carved by a randomised depth-first search that you watch grow across the screen, with the time it was made left standing as a block of digits somewhere in the maze. Once the maze is complete the path from the entrance at the bottom left to the exit on the right is traced in a second colour, then the screen fades to black and a new maze begins.
The settings are the original's: the size of a maze cell, how long a maze takes to build and to solve, whether to solve it at all, the path and solution colours, the clock size and the 12- or 24-hour clock. Added for Kodi: a wall colour, the option to centre the clock instead of placing it at random, and turning the clock off. Cell sizes are measured on a 1080p screen and scaled, so the maze looks the same at 720p, 1080p and 4K.
extension.disclaimer: This is a native add-on: it is built per platform and Kodi version (this one: Kodi 21 Omega on macOS, Intel and Apple Silicon, and 64-bit Android). It needs OpenGL or OpenGL ES 2.0. ScreenMazer was created by Alex Beals (https://github.com/dado3212/ScreenMazer); this is a C++ port of its maze generator and animation with a new renderer and Kodi settings.
